name: klisten-agentsafe
description: Run an owner-provisioned immutable offline JavaScript recovery workflow under four synthetic faults and read its stored result. Supports fixed-json-recovery-v1, intensity 1 and synthetic-json-transform only. No caller code, images, live models, external effects or general agent-safety certification. The designated review pilot allows 24 fixed-scenario operations total and has API/OAuth access until November 11, 2026 at 04:32:42 UTC; the 24-operation total includes prior verification and is not renewed. Other accounts require owner provisioning. Requires an existing Klisten account and product-scoped OAuth; no payment occurs on connection.
